in_marathi.name: Satyajeet
in_marathi.long_meaning: Satyajeet हे एक हिंदू नाव आहे जे भारतीय संस्कृतीत खोल आध्यात्मिक महत्त्व ठेवते। The name Satyajeet is derived from Sanskrit words 'Satyam' which means truth and 'Jay' which means victory. Satyajeet is a powerful name that represents the triumph of truth over falsehood.
